page.title: PostTrainLLM — Build and measure specialist LLMs on a Mac
page.description: Build bounded specialist language models sized to one Apple Silicon machine, then distill, fine-tune, evaluate, package, and inspect them with reproducible…

og.title: PostTrainLLM — Build and measure specialist LLMs on a Mac
og.description: A one-machine research lab for bounded specialists: fine-tune, evaluate honestly, package for MLX, and publish the evidence.

hero.title:
build a specialist.
*prove it on one Mac.*
hero.lede: Turn a stock open model into a routed specialist on one Mac — then measure every win and regression. Distill, fine-tune, evaluate, package for MLX, and inspect the result.

items.title: qwen3-4b, ReST fused.
items.body: The file-operations route improved depth, removed unexpected side effects, and ran 2.42× faster. Breadth fell on the same frozen evaluation. Retain behind the file-ops route; reject as the general successor.

note.text: regression — five net breadth cases lost. The depth win does not justify general promotion.

blocks.title: reach frontier capability. understand the machine.
blocks.lede: Be best-in-class at what one Apple Silicon machine can actually do: train, post-train, evaluate, serve, inspect. No cluster and no cloud dependency.

points.title: learn the whole space
points.body: From y = mx + b to a self-improving factory. Reproduce techniques locally or integrate the best tools, anchored to evidence and the files where they live.

points.title: show the scars
points.body: Failed runs are first-class. Every attempt keeps the decision it forced. A result carries its regression. Build everything buildable here, then package it so the lab can scale when compute arrives.

items.title: each surface feeds the next.
items.body: Every run ends in a schema-valid folder — config, dataset, eval, decision, report — that factory-run validates.

code.label: a bounded file-operations run
code.code:
target      file operations
data        interleaved + depth anchor
post-train  teacher-free ReST
eval        frozen depth + breadth gates
package     fused bf16 · HF/MLX
decide      routed-ship

items.title: qwen3-0.6b, routed SQL.
items.body: Reference-anchored DPO cured a policy collapse and improved synthetic execution. Output hygiene did not improve: the small adapter could not strip the base model’s prose wrapper. This remains a report-only candidate.

note.text: blocked — clean output still fails. Decision: retry-data; execution alone is not a ship gate.

blocks.title: a factory for specialists.
blocks.lede: Models and runs are deliberately bounded to the hardware. A specialist beats a generalist on its target and routes away when it should not answer.

points.title: what it is
points.body: A single-developer, MIT-licensed research lab. Mac-first: M-series, unified memory, MLX-Swift. An OpenAI-compatible runtime. A research-only routed ship, with missing evidence disclosed.

points.title: what it isn’t
points.body: A general assistant, multi-GPU or distributed training, or a cloud product. The ReST package is not product-default proof: runtime promotion still needs a fresh Pace-specific gate. Nothing leaves the laptop unless you ask.

items.kicker: run it · one Mac · from source
items.title: build. inspect. validate.
items.body: Use the native quickstart for a real Mac-local factory run. The browser playground is a bounded learning demo, not the specialist factory.

code.label: zsh — build and validate the native factory
code.code:
# build the native factory
git clone https://github.com/PostTrainLLM/posttrainllm.git
cd posttrainllm/native-mac
xcrun swift build -c release
BIN=.build/release/posttrainllm

# inspect the current factory surface
$BIN --help
$BIN factory-run validate ../runs/<run-id>

blocks.title: the result distribution, without spin.
blocks.lede: {attemptCount} resolved attempts: {workedCount} worked cleanly, {caveatCount} worked with caveat, and {nonPositiveCount} failed, regressed, were rejected, inconclusive, or superseded. A caveated mechanism proof is not a positive product result. Boundary evidence stays visible.

footer.summary: Build the specialist. Measure the tradeoff. Keep the evidence.

directories.lede: Run the native factory, inspect a bounded browser mechanism, read the evidence, or follow the learning journey.
